description.summary: The target of this ninjutsu receives the Slow status effect
description.value: The target of this ninjutsu receives the Slow status effect. A slowed creature can take only a single move action or standard action each turn, but not both (nor may it take full-round actions ). Additionally, it takes a –1 penalty on attack rolls, AC, and Reflex saves. A slowed creature moves at half its normal speed (round down to the next 5-foot increment), which affects the creature’s jumping distance as normal for decreased speed. Multiple slow effects don’t stack. This ninjutsu counters and dispels haste.
